description: Person alias dictionary for the Virginia Company records. Each person has observed alias spellings plus the source and historical basis of the identification. 'excluded' lists frequent name strings deliberately not assigned to anyone, with the reason.

Edwin Sandys.basis: 'S' Edwin' (Sir Edwin) in the records is Sir Edwin Sandys.

John Smyth of Nibley.basis: Named with Berkeley, Thorpe, Throckmorton and Yeardley in the Berkeley Hundred grants and indentures.

John Woodlief.basis: Captain John Woodlief of Berkeley Hundred.

Robert Rich.basis: 'Robert Earle' groups are truncated 'Robert Earle of Warwick'.

Henry Wriothesley.basis: Henry Wriothesley, 3rd Earl of Southampton; Company treasurer 1620-1624. 'Henry Earle' groups are truncated 'Henry Earle of Southampton'.

Thomas Gibbs.basis: Only Gibbs among Company members in the records.

George Calvert.basis: Sir George Calvert, Secretary of State 1619-1625.

Robert Johnson.basis: Alderman Robert Johnson, deputy treasurer under Sir Thomas Smythe.

Roger Smith.basis: Spelling variant of Captain Roger Smith.

Samuel Wrote.basis: Mr Samuel Wrote of the 1623 Company disputes; no other Wrote in the records.

John King, Bishop of London.basis: John King was Bishop of London 1611-March 1621, the span of Volume I.

Thomas Cecil, Earl of Exeter.basis: Thomas Cecil, 1st Earl of Exeter (earl 1605-1623); named in the 1609 charter.

William Cavendish, Lord Cavendish.basis: William, Lord Cavendish (later 2nd Earl of Devonshire), leading Sandys-party member.

Thomas Winston.basis: Dr Thomas Winston, physician and Company member.

Lawrence Hyde.basis: Lawyer and Company counsel; spelling variants.

Patrick Copland.basis: East India Company chaplain who raised funds for the East India School; only Copland in the records.

Christopher Lawne.basis: Founder of Lawne's plantation (Isle of Wight Plantation).

Edward Waterhouse.basis: Company secretary, author of the 1622 massacre Declaration.

Maurice Berkeley.basis: Sir Maurice Berkeley, MP and Company member.

Thomas Kiteley.basis: As on the sheet; possibly Keightley, kept separate.

Edward Cecil.basis: Sir Edward Cecil, general in the Low Countries.

Nicholas Hyde.basis: Nicholas Hyde, lawyer (later Lord Chief Justice).

John Zouch.basis: Sir John Zouch; distinct from Edward, Lord Zouch.

Thomas Wood.basis: English and Latin forms; distinct from Ambrose Wood.

Matthew Somers.basis: Nephew and heir of Sir George Somers; distinct person.

George Tucker.basis: Distinct from Daniel and William Tucker.

Thomas Sandys.basis: Distinct from Edwin, George and Samuel Sandys.

Christopher Davison.basis: Christopher Davison, Secretary of the colony 1621-1623.

Henry Montagu, Viscount Mandeville.basis: Lord President of the Council from 1621.

Jabez Whitaker.basis: Lieutenant Jabez Whitaker, commander at Kecoughtan.

Richard Weston.basis: Sir Richard Weston, Chancellor of the Exchequer.

John Huddleston.basis: Ship captain who relieved the colony in 1622.

Greville Pooley.basis: Minister Greville Pooley; only Pooley in the records.

Julius Caesar.basis: Sir Julius Caesar, Master of the Rolls.

excluded.M’ Deputy: Office; held by John then Nicholas Ferrar.
excluded.Deputy Ferrar: Office held by both John and Nicholas Ferrar.
excluded.Iohn Smith: Several John Smiths; mostly Captain John Smith but not reliably.
excluded.John Smith: Bare/'Mr' John Smith is not reliably Captain John Smith; titled Captain forms are already aliases.
excluded.De Lawar: Henry, 4th Lord De La Warr, or Lady Cicely; not Thomas.
excluded.Richard Sherife: Two people (the elder and the younger).
excluded.Henry Earle: Truncated; see Henry Wriothesley extra alias.
excluded.Robert Earle: Truncated; see Robert Rich extra alias.
